FAQ

Questions about gym & fitness software

How do gyms reduce member churn?

Track attendance, flag members who stop visiting and send timely renewal and win-back offers. Sarvlekh automates these nudges and shows churn risk per member.

Does it support biometric attendance?

Yes. QR, face and fingerprint devices can be integrated, with auto-blocking on expiry.

Can we sell supplements through it?

Yes. A built-in POS tracks retail stock and sales.

Can the gym & fitness system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the gym & fitness system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
